questions.question: What does BERT stand for?
questions.gold_answer: Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers

questions.question: Who are the authors of the BERT paper?
questions.gold_answer: Jacob Devlin, Ming-Wei Chang, Kenton Lee, Kristina Toutanova

questions.question: What are the two pre-training tasks used in BERT?
questions.gold_answer: Masked Language Model (MLM) and Next Sentence Prediction (NSP)

questions.question: What is the architecture of BERT?
questions.gold_answer: Transformer-based architecture with bidirectional attention

questions.question: How does BERT differ from previous language models?
questions.gold_answer: BERT uses bidirectional training instead of unidirectional

questions.question: What datasets were used to train BERT?
questions.gold_answer: BooksCorpus (800M words) and English Wikipedia (2,500M words)

questions.question: What are the two model sizes of BERT?
questions.gold_answer: BERT-Base (110M parameters) and BERT-Large (340M parameters)

questions.question: What evaluation metrics were used in the BERT paper?
questions.gold_answer: GLUE, SQuAD, and SWAG benchmarks

questions.question: What is the context of the BERT paper?
questions.gold_answer: NLP pre-training and language understanding

questions.question: What conclusion does the BERT paper draw?
questions.gold_answer: BERT achieves state-of-the-art results on many NLP tasks

questions.question: What is the Transformer architecture?
questions.gold_answer: Neural network architecture using self-attention mechanisms

questions.question: What is the [CLS] token used for in BERT?
questions.gold_answer: Classification token used for downstream tasks

questions.question: What is the [SEP] token used for in BERT?
questions.gold_answer: Separator token used to distinguish sentences

questions.question: How many epochs was BERT trained for?
questions.gold_answer: 1 million steps on BooksCorpus and Wikipedia

questions.question: What was BERT's performance on SQuAD v1.1?
questions.gold_answer: 93.2% F1 score

questions.question: What is the learning rate used in BERT training?
questions.gold_answer: 1e-4 for BERT-Large, 2e-5 for fine-tuning

questions.question: What is the WordPiece tokenizer?
questions.gold_answer: Subword tokenization method used in BERT

questions.question: What are the limitations of BERT?
questions.gold_answer: Compute-intensive, limited context length (512 tokens)

questions.question: How does BERT handle out-of-vocabulary words?
questions.gold_answer: WordPiece tokenizer splits OOV words into subwords

questions.question: What is the contribution of the BERT paper to NLP?
questions.gold_answer: Introduced pre-training and fine-tuning paradigm for NLP
